deadlineCauseAndFix.demonstratedDefect: cold-cancellable-query-worker captures query/cancel during its deliberate600ms delay, but removed that buffer BEFORE awaiting cancellable-query-worker's async imports. The imported fixture installs bootstrap heartbeat/control listeners before it installs production RPC. During that interval MessagePort is already consumed, so query/cancel arriving after delay are neither queued natively nor saved in the deferred list. A heartbeat can remain responsive while the query is silently discarded and the unchanged400ms caller expires.
deadlineCauseAndFix.correction: Keep existing cold fixture buffer installed through the import; transfer its saved mailbox synchronously in the await continuation after imported fixture installs RPC. Current imported production query module ends handler installation without a later async yield, and cancellable fixture tail emits phase/receipt synchronously. Remove buffer before replay, so replayed messages are not captured recursively. No new production listener, retry, receipt/readiness policy or deadline.
